actions.command: ls -la /var/lib/failover/ 2>&1; echo ---; for f in /var/lib/failover/*; do echo "== $f"; cat "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -c 300; echo; done

actions.description: List listening ports and related processes
actions.command: ss -tlnp 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo ---; ps aux | grep -iE 'failover|proxy|replica|primary|8080|8081|8082' | grep -v grep

actions.description: Read failover state files as text
actions.command: ls -la /var/lib/failover/; echo ---; for f in replica.role upstream primary.failed primary.fenced; do echo "== $f"; cat -A "/var/lib/failover/$f" 2>&1 | head -5; done; echo ---; file /var/lib/failover/records.sqlite3 2>/dev/null; ls -la /var/lib/failover/records.sqlite3

actions.description: Read proxy and replica source code

actions.command: systemctl list-units --all 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'failover|primary|replica|proxy'; echo ---; systemctl list-unit-files 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'failover|primary|replica|proxy'; echo ---; for u in $(systemctl list-unit-files 2>/dev/null | grep -iE 'failover' | awk '{print $1}'); do echo "== $u"; systemctl cat "$u" 2>/dev/null; done
